title: IVG Intense Salts Pro Blue 10ml Nic Salts E-Liquid
description: IVG Intense Salts Pro Blue combines the sweet sharpness of Raspberry with the juicy depth of Blueberry, rounded off by a brisk Ice finish. The result is a fruity vape with both bright tang and a clean coolness. Blended at 50VG/50PG, this Nic Salt provides consistent flavour, discreet vapour, and a tactile yet comfortable throat hit. Available in 10mg and 20mg strengths, Pro Blue is ideal for mouth-to-lung (MTL) devices including pod kits, pens, and starter systems. Part of the IVG Intense Salts range, Pro Blue delivers a berry mix with an icy edge.
